tools.name: search-content
tools.description: Search the Summiz content catalog. Returns videos and podcasts matching the query. IMPORTANT: Use SHORT keywords (1-2 words max) separated by commas. Each keyword segment should be a BIGRAM at most. Examples: 'tomato pruning, organic fertilizer' or 'container gardening' NOT 'how to grow tomatoes in containers at home'. Defaults to the public catalog; set scope='library' to search only the user's own saved library, which requires a connected Summiz account.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10)

params.name: query
params.description: Search keywords. Use SHORT phrases (1-2 words max), comma-separated. Examples: 'tomato pruning, organic fertilizer' or 'container gardening'. Avoid long phrases like 'how to grow tomatoes in container

params.name: scope
params.description: Search scope. 'catalog' (default) searches the public Summiz catalog; 'library' searches only the user's saved library and requires a connected Summiz account.

tools.name: search-youtube-videos
tools.description: Search YouTube videos by keywords to obtain videoId and URL, optionally inside one channel. Each video comes with its channel (channelId, channelHandle), upload date, duration, whether it is a Short, aspect ratio, views, likes, comments and a thumbnail URL, so you can pick one without opening it. channelQuery is a filter, not a keyword: a handle (@polymatter), channel URL, channel ID or video URL picks that channel; a plain name works only when one channel clearly carries it, otherwise the call

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order. Use 'date' for latest uploads, 'relevance' for best semantic match.

params.name: maxResults
params.description: Maximum number of YouTube results to return (default: 5, max: 25).

params.name: titleQuery
params.description: Keywords to search for in video titles and descriptions (e.g., 'the problem with saas').

params.name: channelQuery
params.description: The one channel to search in: a handle ('@polymatter'), channel URL, channel ID, or a name that clearly identifies one channel ('juan ramon rallo'). Results come only from that channel; an ambiguous n

tools.name: resolve-youtube-channel
tools.description: Find the YouTube channel behind a name, handle or URL, with its channelId, handle, subscribers and video count. A handle (@polymatter), channel URL, channel ID or video URL names exactly one channel. A plain name resolves when one channel clearly carries it (status 'resolved', with the other matches in alternatives); otherwise status is 'ambiguous' and candidates lists the channels it could mean, the ones carrying that exact name first. Never returns videos. Pass the handle on to list-youtube-ch

params.name: query
params.description: A channel name ('Modern MBA'), handle ('@polymatter'), channel URL ('https://www.youtube.com/@polymatter'), channel ID ('UC…'), or the URL of one of its videos.

tools.name: list-youtube-channel-videos
tools.description: List the videos one or more YouTube channels uploaded themselves: never re-uploads, reactions or other channels' videos. Up to 10 channels per call, each answered under the string you passed for it. Choose long-form videos or Shorts (tab), newest or most viewed first (sort), and optionally a publication window (since, until). Without a window, 'popular' ranks the channel's 200 most viewed; with one, it ranks the videos published in that window. Each video carries the same metadata as search-yout

params.name: tab
params.description: 'videos' (default) for long-form uploads, 'shorts' for Shorts.

params.name: sort
params.description: 'date' (default) for newest first, 'popular' for most viewed first.

params.name: limit
params.description: Videos per channel (default: 10, max: 50).

params.name: since
params.description: Only videos published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

params.name: until
params.description: Only videos published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601).

params.name: cursor
params.description: The nextCursor of a previous call, to continue that channel's list. Pass it with that channel alone.

params.name: channels
params.description: Up to 10 channels: handles ('@polymatter'), channel URLs or channel IDs ('UC…').

tools.name: get-quick-takes
tools.description: Fetch Quick Takes for a specific piece of content. Quick Takes help users decide if content is worth their time. Accepts either a Summiz UID (from search-content or inferred from a Summiz URL) or a YouTube video ID. `externalId` is interpreted as a YouTube video ID; for content from any other origin, use `uid`. Prioritizes UID if both provided.

params.name: uid
params.description: 7-character Summiz unique identifier (from search-content results or inferred from Summiz URL)

params.name: externalId
params.description: YouTube video ID (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'); for content from any other origin, use `uid`

tools.name: get-summary
tools.description: Fetch full Summary for a specific piece of content. Returns comprehensive summary with TLDR, golden nuggets, sections, and conclusion. Accepts either a Summiz UID (from search-content) or a YouTube video ID. `externalId` is interpreted as a YouTube video ID; for content from any other origin, use `uid`. Prioritizes UID if both provided.

params.name: uid
params.description: 7-character Summiz unique identifier (from search-content results or inferred from Summiz URL)

params.name: externalId
params.description: YouTube video ID (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'); for content from any other origin, use `uid`

tools.name: get-notes
tools.description: Fetch Study Notes for a specific piece of content. Notes are the study-grade view of a video, distinct from a Summary: an overview, thematic sections split into individual concepts (each with an 'in other words' restatement), a glossary of key terms, and review questions tagged recall / conceptual / application for self-testing. Accepts either a Summiz UID (from search-content or create-notes) or a YouTube video ID. `externalId` is interpreted as a YouTube video ID; for content from any other or

params.name: uid
params.description: 7-character Summiz unique identifier (from search-content results or inferred from Summiz URL)

params.name: externalId
params.description: YouTube video ID (e.g., 'dQw4w9WgXcQ'); for content from any other origin, use `uid`

tools.name: get-transcript
tools.description: Fetch the full transcript of a video or podcast (the complete text, not an excerpt). Useful when the user asks about details of the source that the Quick Takes or Summary do not cover. Accepts a Summiz UID (from search-content) or an external ID (e.g., a YouTube video ID from the URL); if both are provided, the UID takes priority. If the video is not in Summiz yet, provide youtubeUrl: the transcript is fetched and the video is added to Summiz.

params.name: uid
params.description: 7-character Summiz unique identifier (from search-content results or inferred from Summiz URL)

params.name: externalId
params.description: External resource ID (e.g., YouTube video ID like 'dQw4w9WgXcQ')

params.name: youtubeUrl
params.description: Full YouTube URL. If video not in Summiz, providing this will automatically fetch the transcript.

tools.name: create-summary
tools.description: To create a Full Summary, users must do so from Summiz.ai with an account. This tool automatically generates Quick Takes (free, no account required) and checks if Summary content exists. Returns available content and the digest URL for accessing or generating Summary content.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for the content (default: EN). Determines the language of the generated content.

params.name: youtubeUrl
params.description: Full YouTube video URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ)

tools.name: create-quick-takes
tools.description: Create Quick Takes for a YouTube video that is not on Summiz yet. Generation typically completes within 3 minutes.

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for the Quick Takes (default: EN). Determines the language of the generated content.

params.name: youtubeUrl
params.description: Full YouTube video URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ)

tools.name: create-notes

Where a Summary condenses a video into TLDR, golden nuggets and prose sections, Notes restructures it for LEARNING: an overview, thematic sections broken into individual concepts (each with a plain-language 'in other words' restatement), a glossary of key terms, and recall/conceptual/application review questions to self-test with. Free and no account required. Generation is progressive — the phases (sections, glossa

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for the Notes (default: EN). Determines the language of the generated content.

params.name: youtubeUrl
params.description: Full YouTube video URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ)

tools.name: list-digests
tools.description: List digests without a search query. The default 'catalog' scope returns the most recent public Summiz digests (newest first) for a language. Set scope='library' to list the user's own saved digests, most recently added first — this requires a connected Summiz account. The 'language' parameter applies to the catalog only; library results come back in each item's saved language.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of digests to return (default: 10)

params.name: scope
params.description: List scope. 'catalog' (default) lists recent public Summiz digests; 'library' lists the user's saved digests and requires a connected Summiz account.

params.name: language
params.description: Catalog language code (default: en). Applies to the catalog scope only; library results use each item's saved language.

tools.name: clickbait-defender
tools.description: Audits the deal between a video's packaging and what its transcript actually pays. A YouTube URL accompanied by 'CD' (shorthand for Clickbait Defender) is a request for this tool. Returns the questions the title and thumbnail made you click on, each answered from the transcript, plus an honesty score (100 = every promise paid in full, 0 = the promise goes entirely unpaid or the video's own content refutes it), timestamped signal peaks, and a watch-if line. Creating the report takes ~20-60 second

params.name: language
params.description: Language code for the report (default: the video's original caption language, else EN). Determines the language the defense is written in.

params.name: youtubeUrl
params.description: Full YouTube video URL (e.g., https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ or https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ)
